name: Gait Recognition in the Wild (GREW)
description: Large-scale gait recognition benchmark collected from natural videos, with 26K identities, 128K sequences, and more than 233K distractor sequences. Dataset access and terms are managed by the benchmark upstream.
citation: Zhu, Zheng, Xianda Guo, Tian Yang, Junjie Huang, Jiankang Deng, Guan Huang, Dalong Du, Jiwen Lu, and Jie Zhou. ‘Gait Recognition in the Wild: A Benchmark.’ Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2021, pp. 14789–14799.

license.notes: Dataset license is unverified; no license terms were confirmed in the published paper or upstream information.
